target: test whether the fixed-k strong-backdoor machine can cover a scalable family

family.construction: G_t is the conjunction of t variable-disjoint copies of the base gadget.
family.local_fact: Assigning any one variable of a gadget reduces all of its clauses to width <=2, so one hit per gadget is sufficient for a 2-SAT backdoor.
family.obstruction_fact: An untouched gadget remains width-3, non-Horn, non-dual-Horn, non-renamable-Horn, not an exact four-clause XOR bundle, and not a complete assignment-blocking cube. Therefore any strong backdoor into the current authoritative frozen terminal portfolio must hit every gadget.
family.proof_style: disjoint-support hitting lower bound; no exponential search required

consequence: For every fixed k there exists G_{k+1} outside the R44E radius-k backdoor machine.
